subject.title: fix(gateway): cap sessions.get when numeric limit is huge

question: Should `sessions.get` formally adopt the same silent 1000-message maximum already used by `chat.history` and session-history HTTP?
rationale: The cap prevents oversized transcript scans and aligns sibling surfaces, but it also changes the result for currently accepted requests above 1000; repository evidence cannot decide that public compatibility tradeoff without Gateway-owner intent.

options.title: Adopt the shared cap
options.body: Accept 1000 as the common Gateway history-page maximum, refresh the branch, and merge the focused implementation and tests.

options.title: Reject silent truncation
options.body: Require oversized `sessions.get` limits to return an explicit validation error or use a separately approved pagination contract instead of silently capping them.

options.title: Preserve larger requests
options.body: Keep the existing accepted range and address transcript-scan cost through a different reader or pagination design.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared cap
recommendation.body: Accept 1000 as the common Gateway history-page maximum, refresh the branch, and merge the focused implementation and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history work is the clearest provenance for the existing 1000-message sibling contract.
